title: Editor E7: the five transactional widgets are placeable and their checkouts are gated on a connected account (premise re-tested: already true)
detail: RE-TESTED 2026-11-10 (ADR-1082, premise first), same day this row was filed. The row asked for placeable tickets, membership and enroll blocks. That premise is stale: `tickets` and `enroll` are RETIRED function keys (lib/spaces/functions.ts RETIRED_SPACE_FUNCTIONS, LIVE-226) that fold into `events` and `journeys`. All five widgets of BUSINESS-MODEL-PLAN section 116 are placeable today: Booking (booking), Membership (memberships), Donate (donate), Tickets (the events block, with the features block's tickets source) and Enroll (the journeys block). Each checkout already refuses without payouts live and a ready connected account: lib/billing/tickets.ts (payoutsLive), space-donation-checkout.ts (payoutsLive + getConnectStatus on the Space owner), space-membership-checkout.ts (getConnectStatus on the owner), lib/spaces/booking.ts (payoutsLive). Nothing is left to build for E7B; the probe now measures that, so a regression (a block removed, a gate dropped) reopens the row. The E7 detail line that named tickets, membership and enroll as missing is superseded by this.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=fs.readFileSync("lib/entity-blocks/registry.ts","utf8");const miss=["booking","memberships","donate","events","journeys"].filter(id=>!new RegExp("id: ."+id+".,").test(r));const gates=[["lib/billing/tickets.ts",/payoutsLive/],["lib/billing/space-donation-checkout.ts",/getConnectStatus/],["lib/billing/space-membership-checkout.ts",/getConnectStatus/],["lib/spaces/booking.ts",/payoutsLive/]].filter(([f,re])=>!re.test(fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8")));if(miss.length||gates.length){console.error("PROG-E7B: missing blocks "+miss.join(",")+"; ungated checkouts "+gates.map(g=>g[0]).join(","));process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Premise re-tested 2026-11-10: tickets and enroll are retired function keys folded into events and journeys. Passes while all five widgets have a registry block and every checkout reads Connect readiness or payoutsLive.
